approach: Edit the one sentence in crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md that tells the verifier to cite the fmt, clippy and test records under "Checks Athena ran on this tree". Keep the existing sentence and add a short clause: each recorded check the verifier cites goes in that criterion's commands list, exactly as shown under that heading, and quoting it only in evidence text is not enough because D43 reads only the commands list. Leave the 'failed or missing record' sentence and the rest of the prompt unchanged. Add one entry under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md, under Changed, naming job 20261024-033935-c4w4, its empty commands list, D43, and the prompt change. No code, test, or other prompt changes.

decisions.choice: Edit the existing sentence in place by appending one clause that names the commands list and the exact display form.
decisions.reason: The gap is that the sentence says 'cite them' without saying where. A short addition closes it and keeps the prompt within its budget.

rejected.option: Add a new paragraph or a separate rule section.
rejected.why: Larger change than needed and adds verifier tokens for one sentence of meaning.

rejected.option: Change verify.rs or D43 to also read evidence text.
rejected.why: Out of scope by the brief; the fix is to make the verifier fill the field D43 already reads.

decisions.choice: Record the change under Changed in the Unreleased section of CHANGELOG.md.
decisions.reason: Matches how the other prompt-behavior entries in that section are filed; keeps the diff to one file of prose.

rejected.why: Adds structure for a single bullet; Changed already holds the verifier and producer prompt changes.

files.purpose: Append one clause to the sentence under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' that says each cited check goes in that criterion's commands list, exactly as shown there, and that evidence text alone is not enough.
Add one bullet under [Unreleased] > Changed naming job 20261024-033935-c4w4, the empty commands list, D43, and the verifier prompt change.

steps: Read crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md and locate the sentence beginning 'The fmt, clippy and test results under'.

Append one clause after 'Cite them;' stating that each recorded check cited goes in that criterion's commands list exactly as shown under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree', and that quoting it only in evidence text is not enough because D43 reads only the commands list. Do not change other sentences.
Add one bullet under '## [Unreleased]' > '### Changed' in CHANGELOG.md naming job 20261024-033935-c4w4, the empty commands list, D43, and the verifier prompt change.
Run git diff --stat and confirm only the two files changed.
Run cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets -- --nocapture and note the verifier size and pass status.
Run cargo test -p athena-cap-change and confirm it passes.

risks.risk: The added clause pushes the verifier's composed prompt over its token budget.
risks.mitigation: Keep the clause to one sentence; criterion 4 runs the budgets test and prints the size, so an overrun fails it.

risks.risk: A test asserts the exact wording of the existing sentence and fails after the edit.
risks.mitigation: Keep the original sentence intact and only append; criterion 5 runs the athena-cap-change tests.

risks.risk: The verifier still cites checks in evidence text only.
risks.mitigation: The wording names the commands list and states that evidence-only citation is not enough, which is the rule D43 applies; the verifier's own output is the evidence of the fix and is outside this plan's verification.

demonstrations.command: grep -n "commands list" crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md, then read the same line
demonstrations.observes: The sentence names the commands list, says each recorded check cited goes there exactly as shown under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree', and says evidence-text-only citation is not enough because D43 reads only the commands list.

demonstrations.command: Read CHANGELOG.md lines 1-20 and grep for 'c4w4' and 'D43'
demonstrations.observes: An entry under the [Unreleased] heading names job 20261024-033935-c4w4, the empty commands list, D43, and the verifier prompt change.
Only crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md and CHANGELOG.md appear in the diff against the base.
The every_role_set_is_within_its_budget test passes, and the printed verifier size is inside the verifier budget.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the added clause pushed the change verifier set over its budget, check_budget returns an error and the test fails.

demonstrations.observes: All tests in athena-cap-change pass, including any that read the verifier prompt text.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the edit broke a test that reads the prompt, or removed the sentence a test looks for, the crate test run fails.

open_questions: The budget ceiling for the verifier set is not stated in the brief; I did not read budgets.rs or the BudgetSet constants. The size after the edit is not measured here; the budgets test output is the check.
The defaults call for a fresh reader to rate the live prompt at 4 of 5 or higher before completion. That rating is not a plan step I can run; the producer or Athena must obtain it.
Whether the verifier will reliably copy the command text verbatim is a model-behavior question that a prompt edit cannot prove.
